description: Check required columns and cell types against a small explicit schema. Report each violation without silently changing the source values. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Schema maps column names to string, number, integer, boolean or required. Numeric CSV strings can satisfy numeric checks. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: data_validate
title: Validate a dataset schema
